new.story: A 2013 British penny with Elizabeth II on the obverse. Copper-plated steel, 20.3mm — the smallest coin in circulation. The shield-design pennies like this one were meant to piece together into the full Royal Shield across denominations.
new.notes: Blind double-read. Legend ELIZABETH II D G REG F D 2013 read character by character. Copper color eliminates silver/gold denominations; measured ~20.7mm vs 20.3mm (1p) spec — 2p at 25.9mm decisively eliminated.
